items.title_zh: 波浪肉汁的狂野生活，色彩缤纷的反主流文化偶像
items.summary_en: wavygravy.net Wavy Gravy was born Hugh Romney, and grew up as the neighbor of Albert Einstein in Princeton, New Jersey. Wavy Gravy, a man who embodied the Summer of Love, has been called many things throughout his life. His parents called him “Hugh Nanton Romney Jr.” Jerry Garcia’s daughter called him a “living Buddha.” And a police officer once dubbed Wavy Gravy as “too weird to arrest.” A performer and peace activist who rubbed elbows with Bob Dylan, Lenny Bruce, and the Merry Pranksters, Wavy Gravy famously ran…
items.summary_zh: wavygravy.net Wavy Gravy 原名休·罗姆尼 (Hugh Romney)，在新泽西州普林斯顿与阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦 (Albert Einstein) 为邻居长大。波威·肉汁（Wavy Gravy）是一个象征着爱之夏的人，在他的一生中被称为许多名字。他的父母称他为“小休·南顿·罗姆尼”。杰里·加西亚的女儿称他为“活佛”。一名警察曾称“Wavy Gravy”“太奇怪了，无法逮捕”。一位表演者和和平活动家，与鲍勃·迪伦、莱尼·布鲁斯和我有过交往

items.title_en: Thomas Jefferson’s DNA Has Officially Proven That He Fathered Children With Sally Hemings
items.title_zh: 托马斯·杰斐逊的 DNA 已正式证明他与莎莉·海明斯生下了孩子
items.summary_en: National Portrait Gallery Historians have long agreed that Thomas Jefferson fathered children with an enslaved woman named Sally Hemings — and recent DNA evidence has backed this up more than ever before. Thomas Jefferson, the third U.S. president and main author of the Declaration of Independence , was an outspoken critic of slavery. However, he kept more than 600 enslaved people at his Virginia home and plantation, Monticello.
items.summary_zh: 国家肖像美术馆的历史学家长期以来一致认为，托马斯·杰斐逊与一位名叫莎莉·海明斯的奴隶妇女生下了孩子，而最近的 DNA 证据比以往任何时候都更加支持这一点。美国第三任总统、《独立宣言》的主要作者托马斯·杰斐逊是奴隶制的直言不讳的批评者。然而，他在弗吉尼亚州蒙蒂塞洛的家和种植园里仍保留着 600 多名奴隶。

items.title_en: The Story Of Stuckie, The Dog That Got Trapped In A Chestnut Oak Tree In Georgia — And Turned Into A Mummy
items.title_zh: 斯塔基的故事，这只狗被困在佐治亚州的一棵栗橡树里，然后变成了木乃伊
items.summary_en: Reddit Stuckie, still stuck in his tree, is on display at the Southern Forest World museum in Georgia. There are some things loggers expect to encounter when cutting down trees, like bird’s nests, woodland creatures, and plenty of insects. But when a group of loggers with the Georgia Kraft Corp. cut down a tree in the 1980s, they came upon a surprising sight: a mummified dog stuck in the tree’s center, who has since been nicknamed “Stuckie.” The dog’s body, which had been trapped in the tree for approximately 20…
